job.style: a passage that starts from a common wrong idea and corrects it

response.passage: Many people believe that the Pushkar Camel Fair is held only to sell animals, but this is a common misunderstanding. While trading is a major part of the event, the fair is primarily a cultural gathering for the people of Rajasthan. In the year 1905, local traders gathered to exchange goods, but today, the fair attracts over 200,000 visitors from across the globe. The event takes place in the month of November, when the desert heat finally begins to fade. Because the cool desert breeze blows across the dunes at night, families find it comfortable to camp under the stars for five days. A local merchant named Arjun Singh explains that the fair is a time for music, dance, and meeting old friends. Another visitor, Meena Devi, travels from Jaipur every year to participate in the traditional turban-tying competition. The fair is not just about camels; it is a vibrant celebration of desert life that brings the community together before the winter season arrives.
response.summary: The Pushkar Camel Fair is more than just a place to trade animals. It is a cultural festival that brings people together in the desert. The event is held in November when the weather is pleasant enough for camping.
